headline: KAI Delivers 13,920 Tons of Fertilizer Through July 2026, Strengthening Agricultural Supply Chain and Food Security
summary: PT Kereta Api Indonesia says it has moved 13,920 tons of fertilizer by rail through July 2026, supporting the national agricultural supply chain and food security.
why: Indonesia's state railway operator handles freight logistics, and reliable fertilizer distribution matters for farm input costs and food supply.
